facts.text: Chatham's 388-acre Eden Hall Campus was created as the world's first university campus designed as a showcase for sustainable solutions.

sources.title: Eden Hall Campus
sources.quote: Nestled on 388 acres of rolling woodlands and fields in Richland Township, PA, you will find the world's first university campus designed to be a showcase for sustainable solutions.

facts.text: Rachel Carson, author of Silent Spring, graduated from Chatham University when it was named the Pennsylvania College for Women.

sources.title: Eden Hall Campus
sources.quote: Pennsylvania College for Women (now Chatham University) graduate Rachel Carson '29 rose to prominence with her book, Silent Spring, as a trailblazing voice questioning the resulting impact of pesticides on people, animals, and the environment.
